entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I bought a jersey a little while ago, and it's just not right. I was so excited for it, but I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's the size. It's just the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but this one is way too tight across the shoulders. I can't even move properly in it.
I see. It sounds like you might need to exchange it for a different size then. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF88602. To be honest, I'm not sure if I want an exchange. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I really needed this money back for some other things right now. It's just been a tough month.
I completely understand. Let me pull up that order... VF88602. Okay, I see it here. It looks like the jersey was delivered to you 34 days ago.
Oh... is that too long? I was hoping it would be okay. I just feel so bad about this.

Not at all. According to our policy, standard items like this jersey have a 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Really? Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. I was so worried. You've really helped me out.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file now. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much, Charlie. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been great.
Great. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
